cuts.head: tilt
cuts.ofreeRecent: a neighbourhood café with a counter and window seats — touches one ear cup of a pair of over-ear headphones hung around her neck; the nave of a Gothic cathedral with stained-glass windows — sitting on the ground; a present-day museum gallery of Three Kingdoms relics — standing; a vast fantasy library of towering shelves — standing; a sunny beach with wet sand and shallow surf — standing; the deck of a tall wooden sailing ship at sea — holds her keepsake at chest height; the long stone stairway of Baidicheng above the Yangtze gorge — holds a gourd-shaped wine flask on a red cord by its cord at chest height; a pilot ready room beside a hangar — standing; a wind-rippled desert dune trail — carries a camera by its grip at her side; a terrace on a castle wall overlooking the valley — looks into a small brass telescope; an underground subway platform — standing; an old stone chapel lit by candles — holds her keepsake up beside her face; a Guan Yu temple — holds a bound bundle of bamboo slips against her chest
